label: Town 4p: Pack-a-Punch fence, pistol in hand
about: All four players spawn around the Pack-a-Punch machine with the chain-link fence behind it and the M1911 in hand (research/signin-run/4way-split-town.png); nobody moves. The match fades in from black a variable time after the map loads, so it captures every 2 s and scores the first 3 frames in play, ending the run there. Catches green/red speckle on the held pistol and the fence drawn as a solid dark sheet.
